title: record-figure
description: The numbers one figure of the solar-weather record states, worked out by the engine (crates/vleo-modules/src/record.rs). A number the record cannot give is null, never a stand-in.

anyOf.description: The density figure: how the two drivers a density model takes sit against each other.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

days.description: Days carrying both F10.7 and Ap.

r.description: Pearson correlation of F10.7 with Ap; null under three days or with no spread.

below_both_pct.description: Per cent of those days below both medians.

storm_ap.description: The daily Ap at or above which a day is a storm day.

storm_deciles.description: How many of the ten F10.7 deciles hold at least one storm day.

anyOf.description: The storm-scale figure: how storms are shared out between the cycles the record holds.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

levels.description: G1 to G3, each with its daily-Ap threshold: the published table's ap at Kp 5, 6 and 7.

cycles.description: The cycles, in the record's table order.

days.description: Days in each cycle carrying an Ap.

max_ap.description: The largest daily Ap in each cycle; null for a cycle with no days.

per_year.description: Days a year at or above each level, per cycle: [level][cycle].

evenness.description: The busiest cycle's G1 rate over the quietest's; null unless two cycles reach G1.

busiest.description: The cycle with the most days a year at each level; null where none has a rate.

anyOf.description: The Kp-against-Ap figure: the daily Ap at each worst three-hourly Kp, beside the published table.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

kp.description: Every worst-slot Kp the record holds, ascending.

table.description: The published three-hourly ap at each Kp; null off the scale.

above_median.description: At how many of those Kp the table is above the median day.

kp7_median.description: The median day at Kp 7; null where the record has none.
